svg.title: Beltline machine catalogue
svg.desc: One of each machine kind in the Beltline kit, joined by belts. Inserter arms load and unload the stores, a diverter flap picks a route, a hash pointer finds a bucket, and an LRU moves a node to the front of its list.
svg.text: Every kit machine with sample values. Illustrative, not a recording.

g.text: 1/23 an inserter lifts the item off the rack and onto the belt
2/23 ring buffer: c lands in the tail sector and the tail arm turns
3/23 hash map: h(k3) = 2, so the pointer drops to bucket 2
4/23 insertion sort: the arm lifts 3, 7 shifts right, and 3 goes in front
5/23 LRU: get(a) hashes to bucket 0 and finds node 2
6/23 the arm lifts a off the LRU end, the others slide down, a goes to MRU
7/23 the tokenizer cuts a number and hands it to the branch
8/23 branch: kind == num, so the flap swings to the upper route
9/23 the press renders a glyph and an inserter drops it on the plate
10/23 the next token is an operator
11/23 branch: else, so the flap swings down and the lock's gate turns
12/23 deque: push_front puts a at the front mouth
13/23 pop_back sends d on; the heap receives 1 in its last slot
14/23 heap: 1 is smaller than its parent 4, so they swap
15/23 1 is smaller than the root 3, swap again: the minimum is on top
16/23 bloom filter: three hashes of cat light bits 2, 7 and 10
17/23 DP table: each cell is filled from the one above and to the left
18/23 graph: a traversal visits A, then follows the edge to B
19/23 B's only edge leads to C, which A also reaches directly
20/23 the visit is published as an event
21/23 broadcast: every subscriber gets a copy; the counter ticks, the arena bumps
22/23 merge: both streams join into one
23/23 the joined result reaches the subscriber
